mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.title AS title, i.file_data AS imgUrl FROM auction a JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key JOIN ( SELECT prod_key, MIN(reg_date) AS min_regdate FROM file GROUP BY prod_key ) fi ON p.prod_key = fi.prod_key JOIN file i ON i.prod_key = fi.prod_key AND i.reg_date = fi.min_regdate WHERE a.host_id = #{loginId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.title, i.file_data;

SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.session, a.title, u.user_name AS auctioneer, a.start_time AS date, COUNT(p.prod_key) AS itemCount FROM auction a LEFT JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.login_id WHERE a.auction_id = #{auctionId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.session, a.title, u.user_name, a.start_time;
